title: Purchase order
passage:
Has the purchase order been released?
A. The release button is red.
B. I prefer ordering tea.
C. It is still waiting for finance approval.
passageZh:
採購單已經發出了嗎？
A. 釋放按鈕是紅色的。
B. 我比較喜歡點茶。
C. 它還在等財務部核准。
